title: Words and lines to read (lesson 55)
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-'Adiyat, Az-Zalzalah and reading from the mushaf
source: Seeded from quran/y2 lesson 55 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words and lines to read)
intro: Lesson 55: Reading from the mushaf: madd and shaddah in Az-Zalzalah. To understand how to read madd letters and shaddah correctly when reading Az-Zalzalah from the mushaf

questions.model: I do: تُ (tu), حَدْ then دِ (had-di), ثُ (thu): tuhaddithu.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read Az-Zalzalah 99:1 to 5 from the mushaf; circle madd in blue and shaddah in green. The teacher listens to today's group.
questions.a: Madd and shaddah found and read.
questions.model: The teacher circles the two madd in «زِلْزَالَهَا».

questions.q: Back to our ponder: Some sounds are long and some are said twice. How does that help the words sound right?
questions.a: Madd makes a sound long (aa, oo, ee); shaddah makes us say a letter twice, so every word is said exactly.
